modifications: Adapt HLSL texture and cbuffer bindings to bgfx shader language.
Combine separable Gaussian and four-tap downsample with explicit mode.
Filter premultiplied RGBA; apply vertex tint after convolution.
Retain normalized five-sample weights and offsets.
noise_modifications: Translate gradient-noise functions from HLSL to bgfx shader language.
Use fixed four-octave bounded fractal; omit upstream bias and dynamic iteration controls.
Use aspect-correct coordinates, bounded seed/phase and premultiplied palette interpolation.
Guard gradient normalization against zero length.
mapping_modifications: Adapt forward polar coordinate mapping, radial power, travel and twist to bgfx.
Bound center radius, support negative radial power for tunnel perspective, mirror edge coordinates explicitly.
Omit inverse mode and external API types; preserve premultiplied RGBA.
